scope: Joint discrete transition of 18 explicit physical gates; imposed V and causal-phase calcium bridge, unchanged algebraic readout. Not a complete compartment or independent confirmation.
loss: Mean squared gate increment error divided by fit-only per-gate RMS increment (floor 0.001), plus mean squared individual current error divided by fit-only per-channel RMS current (floor 1e-7). Sum independent member losses before Adam, per-member norm clipping at 1.
architecture: V plus 17 old voltage-dependent gates -> shared SiLU hidden layer -> 17 candidates and update fractions (sigmoid); convex physical-state update. Separate learned two-input SK head (old SK and log10 bridge Ca) in phase C. No canonical rate evaluation or teacher next-state at inference. Width64 hidden prefix is initialized identically to width32 per seed; extra units independent. SK identical initialization across widths.
phase: A: update 17 V gates without any bridge Ca input; readout Ca source. B: unchanged external CaDynamics supplies bridge (prescribed here). C: update SK with bridge and old SK. D: unchanged 11-channel readout. dt fixed 0.1ms.
sampling: Deterministic fit-only stratified pool, at most 32768 distinct trajectory/tick pairs per family, equal pool size across families. Uniform minibatches from equal-size family pools; shared indices across all six members. Exposure counts saved. fit_extra reserved for Task39 diversity contrast.
selection: Per member minimum fixed development one-step normalized gate+individual-current loss at registered checkpoints; ties earlier. Full free-running development and stress evaluated only after this freeze; no retrospective reselection from rollout failures. Selection does not certify recurrence.
quality: Reuse Task37 quality thresholds verbatim, all channels and trajectories; no averaging away worst-case or rare failures. Report per-case metrics and gates, event support, long recovery, same-V histories, horizons and drift. Stress is separate from in-domain pass.
baselines: frozen IE-P6 local161 discrete coefficient map plus canonical SK (partial replacement)

hypotheses.joint_learnability: A bounded state-conditioned joint map can learn the explicit transition without canonical rates in inference.
hypotheses.capacity: Width64 reduces development and long-recurrence errors relative to paired width32; a win is descriptive unless replicated in Task39.
hypotheses.budget: Saved checkpoints distinguish insufficient optimization from a flat error floor within this budget; no proof of asymptotic scaling.
hypotheses.recurrence_gap: Small teacher-forced error may coexist with long-horizon drift; explicit free-running evaluation must detect it.
hypotheses.causal_memory: Matched same-V different-history responses survive without hidden teacher-state correction. SK must not leak bridge Ca into phase A.

preflights: Dataset hashes, formula FP32 vs stored targets, independent-vs-batched clipped Adam, exact blocked currents, occupancy invariance, Ca dependency mask, compiled vs eager and chunked CUDA graph recurrence vs eager. Abort technical failures before full training.
runtime: CUDA FP32, TF32 off, deterministic algorithms, independent member parameters/Adam moments. No NEURON import. CUDA graph chunks preserve state; no reset between chunks. No speedup claim from this training acceleration.
cost: Architecture parameter counts and GPU execution times logged. Matched inference speed and complete local cost are decision gates of Task40, not established by training throughput.
limits: No new sealed test, no autonomous V/Ca, no emergent spike/bifurcation claim, no spatial transfer, no replacement of membrane/synapses/calcium. Task39 retains loss/coverage contrasts. A scientific NO-GO still produces final_report; runtime failures produce failure_report and are not model NO-GO.
